methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: The EPI is a stochastic frontier model of plant level energy use that enables comparison across facilities with different levels and types of production related activities that influence energy use.

paper_type.evidence_quote: Data on energy use, production, capacity, and vehicle size, was received from 33 plants operating in the United States from six companies; Ford, General Motors, Honda, Nissan, Subaru, and Toyota.

level_3b.evidence_quote: This paper discusses the data and the underlying stochastic frontier analysis used to estimate version two of the ENERGY STAR EPI for motor vehicle assembly plants.

stage1.notes: Application covers 33 U.S. automobile assembly plants from six companies; automobile assembly is discrete manufacturing, outside the closed Level 3B sector list.
